parity.scope: Raw immutable production source, not raw primary-origin response

primaryRawComparison.interpretation: Raw primary tree-current did not pass. All 280 differing HTML bodies are accounted for by the separately verified provider transport.

primaryHtml.policy: Original HTML bytes remain strictly compared. Only response nonce attributes and one exact appended observed Cloudflare script template are accounted for. Only provider request/time fields vary in that exact template. Declared redirects and same-path canonical slash redirects are checked. Provider DOM nonce must match the enforced response CSP. Unchanged protected identity routes are held, not passed. Worker-declared legacy aliases are verified against committed Worker source.
primaryHtml.limits: Non-HTML primary redirects do not prove journeys. Held identity redirects do not prove authenticated flows.

staging.candidateRelationship: Critical artifact root matches the rebased candidate; observed CI metadata differs.

rollback.method: Confirmed production promotion of prior verified source; GitHub Pages remains the warm rollback origin

scoring: Ten-category website rubric; conversion and field performance unmeasured
